question: The Olympic Games 2024 are scheduled to be held in:
solution:
The correct answer is __Paris__.

__
 
• The 2024 Olympic Games are hosted by France's capital, Paris, and the 2028 US city of Los Angeles.
 
• Sydney city of Australia is located on the banks of the Darling River.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In ancient times it was organized in 1896 in Athens, the capital of Greece.
 
• It was named Olympic because of the sport played on Mount Olympia.
 
• Pierre de Kuvarthen is considered the father of the modern Olympic Games.
 
• The International Olympic Committee was founded in 1894 by Pierre de Kuvarthen. It is headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
• The Olympic Games motto is "Citius-Altius-Fortius".​ 
 
• The five rings on the Olympic emblem are of five colours, red, blue, green, yellow, and black.
 
• These rings represent five continents. (North and South America is considered a continent.)
